Data are currently collected by Shore Station staff and volunteers at Scripps Institution of Oceanography.
Data collected by Shore Station staff started March 2020 to present.
Data ~1950-2020 data were collected by aquarists and volunteers with the Birch Aquarium at Scripps.
Prior to 1950, data were collected by SIO staff and tide observers.
Data uncertainties are flagged with the following codes:
NaN = data not collected,
0 = good data,
1 = illegible entry,
2 = data differs from other sources, ie. temperature vs. salinity records,
3 = data uncertain,
4 = leaky bottle,
5 = sample collected as part of SIO Pier Chlorophyll Program or at different location.
Time flags indicate date or time uncertainties.
Data flags indicate uncertainties with data.
Time of sample collection available for 1990-current data only.
Time records in Pacific Standard time zone (PST).
Time records between 1990-2004 may vary by up to 1 hour with actual sample
time since time zone was not recorded during these years.
